Adults 18+ can take an adoptable shelter dog home for up to two weeks over the holidays, then return it or adopt; sign up at 2811 SE 29th St., Tue-Sat noon-5 pm. The city ran it in 2024 and 2025; a 2026 run is not yet announced.
